pages.title: About Laxmi Cineplex Hazaribagh
pages.content: Laxmi Cineplex is the crown jewel of cinema entertainment in Hazaribagh, Jharkhand. Located conveniently near Jhanda Chowk, our multiplex brings world-class cinematic technology to local cinephiles with high-gain silver screens, Barco 4K Laser projection, and immersive Dolby Atmos 7.1 surround sound. We offer plush VIP recliners, hygienic cafeteria snacks, sanitized auditoriums, and warm Jharkhand hospitality.
pages.metaTitle: About Laxmi Cineplex Hazaribagh - Premier Cinema in Jharkhand
pages.metaDescription: Discover the premier moviegoing destination in Hazaribagh featuring 4K Laser projection and Dolby Atmos 7.1 sound.

pages.title: Terms of Service & Booking Policies
pages.content:
1. Entry is permitted only upon presentation of a valid digital or printed QR e-ticket.
2. In accordance with Indian censorship rules (CBFC), patrons under 18 years will not be admitted to films rated 'A' (Adults Only). No refunds will be provided for age non-compliance.
3. Outside food and beverages, sharp items, and recording devices are strictly prohibited.
4. Cancellations are permitted up to 2 hours before the scheduled showtime for a 75% refund to the original payment source.
5. Seats booked via UPI QR are confirmed upon verified transaction UTR matching with Box Office records.
pages.metaTitle: Booking Terms & Conditions - Laxmi Cineplex Hazaribagh
pages.metaDescription: Read booking, cancellation, and admission policies for Laxmi Cineplex Hazaribagh.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content: Laxmi Cineplex respects your privacy. We collect customer mobile numbers and email addresses strictly for transmitting digital booking confirmations, turnstile entry QR tokens, and important cinema service alerts. We never sell or share patron information with third-party advertisers. All transaction and UTR verification data is handled through encrypted storage.
pages.metaDescription: Learn how Laxmi Cineplex securely handles customer data and transaction records.

pages.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
pages.content:
We offer transparent cancellation on confirmed bookings:
- Up to 2 hours before showtime: 75% refund of ticket value (convenience fees and taxes are non-refundable).
- Within 2 hours of showtime: Non-cancellable.
- If a show is cancelled due to technical difficulties or cinema authority instructions: 100% full refund including taxes is initiated within 24 hours.
- UPI QR bookings rejected due to invalid UTR are marked as cancelled with automatic seat release.
pages.metaDescription: Easy cancellation and refund guidelines for movie tickets at Laxmi Cineplex Hazaribagh.
